ideas.pitch: An Arduino and QTR sensor-based line follower utilizing real-time PID control loops and dynamic lighting calibration to navigate complex tracks without losing grip.
ideas.title: PID-Tuned High-Speed Line Follower with Adaptive Thresholding
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the primary judging criteria of track completion time and path-following accuracy by eliminating oscillation on sharp turns.

ideas.pitch: A compact autonomous robot featuring an IR array for line tracking paired with an ultrasonic sensor module to detect and dynamically reroute around unexpected track blocks.
ideas.title: Dual-Sensor Hybrid Line and Obstacle Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages robust hardware-software integration and handles complex track variations better than basic analog comparators.

ideas.pitch: A high-speed line tracking robot leveraging a low-power FPGA module for parallelized pixel processing from a miniature onboard camera instead of standard IR arrays.
ideas.title: FPGA-Accelerated Vision-Assisted Line Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by moving line detection processing to hardware logic, setting it apart from standard microcontroller builds.

ideas.pitch: A modular 3D-printed chassis robot equipped with magnetic encoders on the wheel motors for precise odometry and automated checkpoint distance logging.
ideas.title: Modular Checkpoint-Recovery Line Tracer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Minimizes manual restart time penalties by tracking exact checkpoint intervals through wheel encoder feedback.

ideas.pitch: An ESP32-powered high-traction line follower that uses an onboard finite state machine to instantly adjust motor PWM profiles based on surface friction and turn sharpness.
ideas.title: State-Machine Managed Multi-Surface Line Racer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Excels on the Round 2 final complex track by adapting speed dynamically rather than running at a flat, conservative rate.
